missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Глупость' is a feminine soft-sign noun in the nominative as the predicate after 'это была'. 'Полная' is the agreeing feminine adjective.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Глупость' is the accusative direct object of the imperative 'не говори'; for this feminine noun the accusative equals the nominative. 'Такую' agrees in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Глупости' is genitive after 'от', marking the cause of tiredness. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Глупости' is dative after 'к', marking what is hard to get used to. 'Твоей' agrees in the feminine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental means. 'Глупостью' is the instrumental naming what he surprised everyone with. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental.

missions.phrase: В этой глупости нет ничего смешного.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Глупости' is the prepositional form after 'в', locating the absence of humor within the foolishness. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Глупость' is the nominative subject of 'раздражает'. 'Его' is the possessive, and 'иногда' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Глупости' is genitive after 'из-за', marking the reason he lost his job. A clean cause-and-effect phrase.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Глупости' is the accusative plural object of 'совершает', matching the nominative plural for this feminine noun. 'Одни' stresses he does nothing but foolish things.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Глупости' is the nominative plural subject of 'удивляют'. 'Такие' agrees in plural, and 'меня' is the accusative object.
